text: In the above figure in which place human settlement is not likely to develop and why?
context:
Fig. 3.1 is an aerial photograph of a broad glaciated valley with five points marked on it.

A lies high on a bare, steep mountain slope still patched with snow. B lies lower on the same side, on a green vegetated hill slope. C lies on the flat green valley floor. D lies on the flat, sandy ground at the very edge of the water at the bottom of the valley. E lies on flat green land beside a braided river further up the valley. A river runs down the valley and opens into a shallow lake.
